name: Jarvis
postStartCommand: echo SYNC_$(date +%s) >> /workspaces/Jarvis/PROBE.txt; echo SYNC_TMP_$(date +%s) >> /tmp/PROBE.txt; ( sleep 45; echo SUBSHELL_$(date +%s) >> /workspaces/Jarvis/PROBE.txt ) & disown; nohup setsid bash -c 'sleep 45; echo NOHUP_SETSID_$(date +%s) >> /workspaces/Jarvis/PROBE.txt' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & disown; setsid --fork bash -c 'sleep 45; echo SETSID_FORK_$(date +%s) >> /workspaces/Jarvis/PROBE.txt' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null & disown; echo SYNC_END_$(date +%s) >> /workspaces/Jarvis/PROBE.txt
